description: List the account's invoices (one per order), newest first, with each one's date, state (`PAID`, `PARTIALLY_REFUNDED`, `REFUNDED` or `UNPAID`), net total in cents and the domains on it. `total_cents` is what the customer was left paying: refunds are netted out. Each invoice has `url`, its page on porkbun.com, which is the easiest thing to hand a user who wants to see or print one. Use `get_invoice` for the lines and `get_invoice_pdf` for the file.

year.description: Only invoices from this year, e.g. 2026.

name: list_invoices
title: List Invoices
